name: Jump To Steal Lucky Blocks
desc:
Jump To Steal Lucky Blocks!

💡 How to Play:
- Jump high and Steal Lucky Blocks hidden on platforms!  🏃‍♂️
- Don't get caught by the Guards! 👮
- Bring them back to your Base to earn Cash! 🏠
- Upgrade your Jump to Reach Higher platforms! ⚡

Your Brainrots earn cash OFFLINE! 💤

Like the game and join the group for FREE cash and a Brainrot! 👍
